terminal_readbacks.label: 玩家只有一张已支付报名单且交易号来自回调
terminal_readbacks.sql: SELECT r.id,r.payment_status,r.transaction_id FROM cms_registration r JOIN cms_activity a ON a.id=r.owner_id AND r.owner_type=2 WHERE a.topic_id=%s AND r.member_id=%s

terminal_readbacks.label: 权益四条全部核销（无多扣/无漏扣）
terminal_readbacks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(status=1),0),COALESCE(SUM(redeemed_at IS NOT NULL),0) FROM registration_entitlement WHERE registration_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM cms_registration r JOIN cms_activity a ON a.id=r.owner_id AND r.owner_type=2 WHERE a.topic_id=%s AND r.member_id=%s)

terminal_readbacks.label: redemption 恰好四行 ACTIVE（无重复核销）
terminal_readbacks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(status='ACTIVE'),0),COUNT(DISTINCT chapter_id) FROM redemption WHERE registration_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM cms_registration r JOIN cms_activity a ON a.id=r.owner_id AND r.owner_type=2 WHERE a.topic_id=%s AND r.member_id=%s)

terminal_readbacks.label: 通关勋章恰好一枚（无重复发放）
terminal_readbacks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_badge WHERE member_id=%s AND source_id=%s
